bases.name: Enniskillen potential community-paramedicine co-use base
bases.notes: Council on June 26, 2023 endorsed pursuit of a lease with Durham Paramedic Services for concurrent use of Fire Station 5 (C-094-23 as amended / C-097-23, item c; Council minutes pp. 7–9). Committee motions on June 19 were lost and referred onward. Signed lease and operational paramedic occupancy are not verified, and the site is not in the Durham emergency-response station GIS. Retain needs-review and exclude from active selection.

constructionProjects.name: Superseded north Bowmanville fire hall at Operations Depot site
constructionProjects.address: 2656 Concession Road 4, Clarington, ON (superseded fire-hall site)
constructionProjects.notes: History only: August 10, 2026 Council removed the fire hall from this depot site because the fire facilities cannot proceed here under Greenbelt constraints. The depot may proceed, but that is not fire-station construction. Completed hall design retained for a future project; need forecast approximately seven to 10 years. No replacement site/project approved in the checked evidence.
